description: Recognizes one-off desktop interaction plus disposable Windows isolation without automation or sandbox jargon.
prompt: Try a 12.50 receipt in Marigold Register on a fresh Sandbox desktop. Does the balance come out right? Send me an image of the result.

paraphrases.novice: Open Marigold Register on a fresh Windows desktop that gets discarded when closed. Click through making a receipt for 12.50, tell me the balance shown, and send me a picture of the screen.
paraphrases.terse: Marigold in Sandbox: enter receipt 12.50, read balance, screenshot.

routingSnapshotReason: A runnable candidate and disposable desktop are represented by artifact metadata and the expected window layout.
